name: Travel agencies and ticketing

problems.words: Enquiries all day on WhatsApp, half never reply after the quote
quick_ideas: Go through last week's quotes once and mark booked, lost or no reply, so you see where people drop off
Follow up every no-reply quote once, so you learn whether it's price or timing.

workzap_build.text: every enquiry from WhatsApp, calls and walk-ins recorded with quote sent, follow-up reminders on time, and a booked or lost reason, with conversion seen per staff member every week.

problems.ask_first: Zyada tar enquiries kahan se aati hain, WhatsApp, walk-in ya calls?
problems.free_stops: Follow-up timing and lost-reason categories are set out in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count yesterday's quoted chats and mark which went silent after the fare, so you see how big the no-reply pile is.
Give one staff member a fixed follow-up time for quoted chats, so late replies stop slipping past the team.

problems.words: Refunds take months and we don't know which are pending
quick_ideas: Count every pending refund and credit shell once with its age, so you know the real backlog
Give the oldest ones to one named person, so someone owns them.

workzap_build.text: a refund and credit shell tracker with status, age and owner, sending customers an update whenever their refund moves.

problems.ask_first: Is waqt taqreeban kitne refunds pending honge?
problems.free_stops: The refund stages and customer update points are designed in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many refund cases had no update this week, so you see which pending work is truly stuck.
Keep one refund pending list in one notebook with one owner, so customers get clearer status when they ask.

problems.words: Bookings expire because nobody issued before the time limit
quick_ideas: List today's open bookings with their time limits once, so you see what's at risk
Make one person check time limits each morning, so it's someone's job.

workzap_build.text: a time-limit alert board that reminds the right staff before each booking expires, so it's issued or released in time.

problems.ask_first: Roz taqreeban kitni bookings hold pe hoti hain?
problems.free_stops: How time limits are pulled in and alerted is set out in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many bookings reached their limit unissued this week, so you see the scale of preventable losses.
Give one person the noon handover list of bookings nearing ticketing limits, so expiry risk gets checked before the rush.

problems.words: ADMs keep arriving for old mistakes
quick_ideas: Sort the last few months' ADMs by cause, so you see which mistake repeats
Share the top causes with ticketing staff, so the same error isn't made again.

workzap_build.text: an ADM log with cause, staff role and cost, showing patterns every month so training goes where the losses are.

problems.ask_first: ADMs mahine mein taqreeban kitne aate hain?
problems.free_stops: The cause categories and reporting are worked out in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Mark each ADM by booking type and staff handover point once, so the repeat break in routine shows.
Give one person the job of logging every new ADM in one notebook, so old mistakes stop getting forgotten between shifts.

problems.words: Corporate clients and sub-agents owe us and BSP is due first
quick_ideas: List everyone on credit with balance and age once, so you see the total exposure
Line up their usual payment dates against BSP dates, so you see the tight weeks.

workzap_build.text: a corporate and sub-agent credit ledger with limits, ageing and reminders sent to clients ahead of BSP dates.

problems.ask_first: Credit sab se zyada kis ko dete hain, corporates ya sub-agents?
problems.free_stops: Credit limits and reminder timing are designed in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many follow ups stay open past the promised date this week, so you see where chasing keeps stalling.
Give one person the job of updating one notebook of promised payment dates daily, so overdue follow ups stop getting missed.

problems.words: Staff quote different markups to different people
quick_ideas: Compare markups on last week's tickets once, so you see how much they vary
Agree a simple markup range by route type, so staff know the limits.

workzap_build.text: standard markup rules applied at quote time, with anything outside the range needing approval and a daily view of markup per staff member.

problems.ask_first: Markup ka faisla abhi kaun karta hai?
problems.free_stops: The markup rules per route and customer type are set out in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare today's quotes on the same route by staff member once, so you see where markup differences are widest.
Give one senior person the job of checking quoted markups at a fixed time, so fare consistency stops drifting across the team.

problems.words: Staff commission calculations cause fights every month
quick_ideas: Write down the commission rule as it stands, so everyone argues from one version
Share each person's sales list before payday, so disputes come early.

workzap_build.text: a commission calculator from confirmed sales, with a monthly statement each staff member can check.

problems.ask_first: Commission profit pe hoti hai ya ticket count pe?
problems.free_stops: The commission rules are configured in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many pay related arguments start from missing booking notes this month, so the main source of fights becomes visible.
Give one supervisor the job of keeping one written log of booking changes each day, so pay discussions start from the same record.

problems.words: Years of customers but we never contact them again
quick_ideas: Pull a list of past customers who agreed to hear from you, so you know who you can contact
Mark which seasons each one usually travels (Eid, summer, Umrah), so contact is timely.

workzap_build.text: a re-contact flow to opted-in past customers before Eid, summer and Umrah seasons, with bookings from each send tracked.

problems.ask_first: Purane customers ke numbers kahan saved hain?
problems.free_stops: The timing, audience groups and tracking are designed in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many past customers were contacted again this month, so you see how much old business is being left idle.
Give one staff member a fixed weekly time to review past customer files, so repeat business gets regular attention.

problems.words: Counter cash doesn't match the day's tickets
quick_ideas: Match one week's counter cash against tickets issued per day, so you see when gaps appear
Make the closing count a two-person job, so differences are noticed the same day.

workzap_build.text: daily counter cash matched against tickets issued, by branch, with differences flagged to the owner each evening.

problems.ask_first: Kitni branches mein cash counter hai?
problems.free_stops: The matching rules and alert levels are set out in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note which days this week issued tickets and counter handovers do not line up, so the trouble period stands out.
Make one person hand over the counter with one written note at closing, so each shift ends with a clear record.

problems.words: Daily sales report built from GDS reports and Excel by hand
quick_ideas: Decide the three numbers you want each morning, so the report gets shorter
Ask who builds it how long it takes, so you know the real cost.

workzap_build.text: a morning read of sales, profit and receipts per branch, pulled from GDS reports and receipts without re-typing.

problems.ask_first: Aap kaun sa GDS use karte hain?
problems.free_stops: How the GDS data is pulled in is worked out in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note each piece you copy by hand for tomorrow's sales report once, so you see which source creates most rework.
Give one person a fixed notebook page for the morning sales totals, so handover stays consistent when shifts change.

never_say: Any visa, immigration, work permit or travel-document advice; only the business problem.
Anything that helps with fake bookings for visa files, forged documents, fake hotel confirmations or travel on wrong documents.
Legal, consumer-law or banking advice on refunds, card fraud or chargebacks; suggest they talk to their lawyer or bank.
Anything near exploitation or misrepresentation in labour travel.
Any storage of traveller names, passport, CNIC or Emirates ID numbers, visa copies or card details.

sample_reply.person: Refunds ka bohat masla hai, customers roz phone karte hain aur humein khud nahi pata kis ka refund kahan atka hai. Kuch batayein.
sample_reply.pi:
Ji haan, ye theek ho sakta hai, aur is ke liye bade kharch ki zaroorat nahi.
Pehle, saare pending refunds aur credit shells ek dafa un ki umar ke saath gin lein, taa ke asal backlog saamne aaye.
Doosra, sab se purane refunds ek tay shuda bande ke hawale kar dein, taa ke koi un ka zimmedar ho.
Is ka pakka hal Workzap ye bana sakta hai: har refund ka status, umar aur zimmedar ek jagah nazar aaye, aur status badalte hi customer ko WhatsApp par update khud chala jaye.
